tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.0.1 - Brand Visual Upgrade: Dual-Page Handwriting-to-Typed Transformation Stream
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.0.1 updates the visual identity across the entire application to the dynamic 'Dual-Page Transformation Stream' emblem. The new 3D design vividly illustrates authentic handwritten yeshiva notes streaming and reconstituting into a clean, razor-sharp printed sefer page.
features: New Visual Identity: Upgraded all icons, splash screens, dialogs, and setup wizard to the 3D Dual-Page Transformation Stream emblem.
100% Offline OCR: Recognizes Hebrew cursive handwriting on standard CPU without internet.
Multi-Image Support: Attach single or multiple pages of notes, reorder, or batch-scan.
Side-by-Side Review: Smooth pan, zoom, and 90-degree rotate alongside a real-time Hebrew RTL editor.
Self-Learning Memory: Automatically identifies and remembers your corrections for all future scans.
Preloaded Yeshiva Lexicon: Built-in knowledge of common Talmudic abbreviations (Roshei Teivot) and terms.
Word Document Export: Generates clean, right-to-left formatted Microsoft Word (.docx) files ready for printing or sharing.
